OrgUnit.name: Privacy

OrgUnit.name: Commercial Product Partnership

Initiative.title: test
Initiative.summary: An instant payout solution enabling Checkout.com merchants, primarily SMBs and marketplaces, to receive funds within minutes to a linked debit card or bank account.
Initiative.description: Merchants currently face 1-3 day settlement times, causing significant cash-flow strain for SMBs and marketplace payees. This initiative addresses that by providing real-time payouts, leveraging new API and dashboard triggers, and supporting key currencies and regions.

test
Initiative.summary: An initiative to build an Instant Payouts solution, enabling Checkout.com merchants to disburse funds in real-time to linked debit cards or bank accounts.
Initiative.description: Merchants, particularly SMBs and marketplace payees, currently face cash-flow strain due to 1-3 day settlement times. This initiative addresses that by providing funds within minutes, targeting Checkout.com merchants who urgently need faster access to their money.

Initiative.title: Rob test 2
Initiative.summary: This initiative approves a 3-year partnership with Clearbank to launch interest-bearing savings accounts for Business and Consumer customers in the UK.
Initiative.description: The goal is to address the 'dead-capital' problem for businesses and the 'savings loyalty penalty' for consumers, as Checkout.com is currently constrained by regulatory restrictions and licensing gaps from paying interest directly. A Banking as a Service (BaaS) model with Clearbank is the only viable approach to offer these products and reach target regions before obtaining a full banking license.

Initiative.title: Issuing Automation Initiative
Initiative.summary: A cloud-based Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system is being implemented to centralize customer data and improve operational efficiency.
Initiative.description: The current customer management processes lack centralisation, real-time reporting, and efficient automation. This initiative aims to address these issues by implementing a new CRM system to improve customer engagement, streamline sales, and enhance reporting capabilities across the organization.

White Label App
Initiative.summary: Checkout.com is building its own branded iOS and Android app that embeds a partner SoftPOS SDK, enabling merchants to accept tap-to-pay on commercial off-the-shelf devices without needing to develop their own application.
Initiative.description: Checkout.com currently processes only card-not-present payments, missing out on the $47.3tn in-person payments market. This initiative aims to expand the addressable market significantly and strengthen the company's ability to compete for enterprise merchants requiring unified omnichannel acquiring. The timing is strategic, leveraging mature SoftPOS technology and a partner ecosystem to enter the market efficiently.

Initiative.title: dom-vas-secure fraud strategy in Sardine - build logic & define monitoring
In-Person Payments - Phase 0
Initiative.summary: This initiative aims to enable in-person payments through a hardware-agnostic approach, initially leveraging partner SoftPOS technology, to expand Checkout.com's addressable market and offer unified acquiring.
Initiative.description: Checkout.com currently operates only in the card-not-present market, missing out on the $47.3 trillion annual point-of-sale payments market, which is 4-5x their current addressable market. Omnichannel acquiring is now a baseline requirement for enterprise merchants, and competitors are already strong in this space. The timing is opportune as SoftPOS technology is mature, hardware lock-in is becoming a liability for merchants, and Checkout.com already possesses the necessary infrastructure.

MALPB (Georgia License) VISA
Initiative.summary: The MALPB (Georgia License) MVP initiative focuses on establishing a Special Purpose Entity (SPE) and associated infrastructure to comply with Visa MALPB Program rules and obtain a Georgia license, enabling merchant settlement.
Initiative.description: This project aims to bridge the gap between strategy and product execution for the MALPB. It involves setting up a bankruptcy-remote SPE to receive card scheme settlement, hold merchant funds, and facilitate settlement, ensuring compliance with Visa requirements and FDIC sub-ledgering rules for FBO accounts. This is crucial for obtaining Visa membership and operating in Georgia.

Initiative.title: ISV Platforms in EEA
Initiative.summary: Launching the Platforms Product in the EEA.
Initiative.description:
Checkout does not have scalable Platform Solution in the EEA. As a result we are losing out on a significant TAM in Europe. 

This iniaitve is focussed on extending coverage of the Platforms Product to the EEA Region.

Initiative.title: Click to Pay (VISA)
Initiative.summary: Integrate Visa Click to Pay (C2P) into the existing Remember Me (RM) checkout flow, enabling C2P users to transact and store credentials via RM while preserving Checkout's control over identity verification and user experience.
Initiative.description: Visa and Mastercard are mandating Click to Pay (C2P) adoption, creating significant compliance risks and potential fines for Checkout.com (CKO) if not integrated. A separate C2P offering would also erode CKO's control and the Remember Me product's value. This initiative is crucial to meet regulatory deadlines, avoid substantial fines, and strategically maintain CKO's ownership of the consumer relationship through RM.

Initiative.title: Mastercard Passkey launch
Initiative.summary: Mastercard Passkey replaces OTP and out-of-band 3DS challenges with FIDO2 biometrics for cardholder authentication. It integrates into Checkout's existing 3DS flow to create and use passkeys for returning cardholders.
Initiative.description: The current 3DS Challenge, relying on OTP/OOB, significantly degrades conversion rates and increases costs for card payments. This initiative aims to address this by offering a premium authentication experience, achieving parity with Visa's offering, and responding to merchant requests for better conversion and reduced fraud.

Initiative.title: Visa Payment Passkey
Initiative.summary: The Visa Payment Passkey initiative aims to monetize premium authentication experiences like Visa/Mastercard Passkeys and Google SPA.
Initiative.description: This initiative transforms authentication from a compliance cost into a conversion product, capturing value from interchange reduction and uplift in successful completions. It focuses on building a self-serve platform to win standalone contracts with marquee brands, decoupling growth from acquiring volume, and achieving a 30% standalone revenue mix by 2027.

Initiative.title: Least cost routing
Initiative.summary: Checkout is implementing a cost-aware intelligence layer into its dynamic routing engine for US debit card transactions, aiming to optimize for cost and authorization performance while monetizing generated savings through a gain-share model with merchants.
Initiative.description: Checkout's current routing for dual-/multi-branded cards uses static logic that fails to optimize for cost or approval rates, resulting in lost Net Revenue for both merchants and Checkout. This initiative is critical now due to existing core routing infrastructure, a demonstrated market opportunity for significant fee savings, its direct contribution to Net Revenue targets, the need for competitive parity, and its potential as a scalable blueprint for other markets.

Initiative.title: ISV Platforms in EEA
Initiative.summary: Launching Platforms in the European Economic Area (EEA)
Initiative.description:
We cannot serve Platform customers in the EEA at scale. The platform product we built serves the US. We wish to expand to serve the EEA region. 

The opportunity is the reason to act. Adyen's Platforms pillar processed €208.5bn in FY2025, up from €76.2bn in FY2021. Checkout's ISV TPV in 2025 was $1.5B. Extending the platform layer into the EU opens a segment we are locked out of.

Do nothing and the EEA stays closed while the US product proves the model. EU marketplaces on the agent-of-payee exemption also have no compliant Checkout option before the December 2027 PSD3 deadline.
